violations.text: The side door to the outside is not tight-fitting (outer door sweep observed in need of replacement. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 10/15/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the outdoor storage area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 10/31/2026
